verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation or independent report specifically describing a tamper-evident audit trail or a Certificate of Completion for signed documents; available material only covers identity verification, fraud-risk reduction, and unrelated product features (e.g., docusign-docs-10, docusign-docs-14/15/26/30). While the axis clearly applies to an e-signature platform, no citation in the pack substantiates this specific capability, so it cannot be scored above 'none'.
